responsibility: This file implements the object-file backend used by LTO to read and write IL sections inside native object files via GCC’s simple-object abstraction. It wraps file descriptors and simple_object reader/writer state in lto_file objects, parses optional filename@offset references, discovers and indexes LTO sections by name and file offset, preserves/merges object attributes across inputs, tracks the current output file/section, and provides the begin/append/end section hooks that the LTO streamer uses when emitting partitioned output objects.
